passages.text: Adam, Seth, Enosh, Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech.
passages.sermon:
Adam was the first man.
Seth was Adam’s son.
Enosh was Seth’s son.
Kenan was Enosh’s son.
Mahalalel was Kenan’s son.
Jared was Mahalalel’s son.
Enoch was Jared’s son.
Methuselah was Enoch’s son.
Lamech was Methuselah’s son.
passages.original: אָדָ֥ם שֵׁ֖ת אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃ קֵינָ֥ן מַהֲלַלְאֵ֖ל יָֽרֶד׃ חֲנ֥וֹךְ מְתוּשֶׁ֖לַח לָֽמֶךְ׃

passages.text: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
passages.sermon: Noah was a man.\r\nNoah had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
passages.original: נֹ֥חַ שֵׁ֖ם חָ֥ם וָיָֽפֶת׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
passages.sermon: Japheth was a son of Noah.\r\nJapheth had seven sons.\r\nTheir names were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י יֶ֔פֶת גֹּ֣מֶר וּמָג֔וֹג וּמָדַ֖י וְיָוָ֣ן וְתֻבָ֑ל וּמֶ֖שֶׁךְ וְתִירָֽס׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
passages.sermon:
Gomer was a son of Japheth.
Japheth was a son of Noah.
Gomer had three sons.
Their names were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י גֹּ֑מֶר אַשְׁכֲּנַ֥ז וְדִיפַ֖ת וְתוֹגַרְמָֽה׃

passages.text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
passages.sermon: Javan was a son of Japheth.\r\nJavan had sons.\r\nJavan’s sons were Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י יָוָ֖ן אֱלִישָׁ֣ה וְתַרְשִׁ֑ישָׁה כִּתִּ֖ים וְרוֹדָנִֽים׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
passages.sermon: Ham was a man.\r\nHam had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י חָ֑ם כּ֥וּשׁ וּמִצְרַ֖יִם פּ֥וּט וּכְנָֽעַן׃

passages.text: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
passages.sermon:
Cush was the father of five sons.
Their names were Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca.
Raamah was the father of two sons.
Their names were Sheba and Dedan.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י כ֔וּשׁ סְבָא֙ וַחֲוִילָ֔ה וְסַבְתָּ֥א וְרַעְמָ֖א וְסַבְתְּכָ֑א וּבְנֵ֥י רַעְמָ֖א שְׁבָ֥א וּדְדָֽן׃ס

passages.text: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
passages.sermon: Cush was the father of Nimrod.\r\nNimrod began to be a mighty one on the earth.
passages.original: וְכ֖וּשׁ יָלַ֣ד אֶת־ נִמְר֑וֹד ה֣וּא הֵחֵ֔ל לִהְי֥וֹת גִּבּ֖וֹר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃ס

passages.text: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites, the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
passages.sermon:
Mizraim was the father of several peoples.
He was the father of the Ludites.
He was the father of the Anamites.
He was the father of the Lehabites.
He was the father of the Naphtuhites.
He was the father of the Pathrusites.
He was the father of the Casluhites.
The Philistines came from the Casluhites.
He was the father of the Caphtorites.
passages.original: וּמִצְרַ֡יִם יָלַ֞ד אֶת־ לוּדִיִּים וְאֶת־ עֲנָמִ֛ים וְאֶת־ לְהָבִ֖ים וְאֶת־ נַפְתֻּחִֽים׃ וְֽאֶת־ פַּתְרֻסִ֞ים וְאֶת־ כַּסְלֻחִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֥וּ מִשָּׁ֛ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ כַּפְתֹּרִֽים׃ס

passages.text: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites, the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites, the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
passages.sermon:
Canaan was the father of many peoples.
Canaan's first son was Sidon.
Canaan was also the father of the Hittites.
Canaan was the father of the Jebusites.
Canaan was the father of the Amorites.
Canaan was the father of the Girgashites.
Canaan was the father of the Hivites.
Canaan was the father of the Arkites.
Canaan was the father of the Sinites.
Canaan was the father of the Arvadites.
Canaan was the father of the Zemarites.
Canaan was the father of the Hamathites.
passages.original: וּכְנַ֗עַן יָלַ֛ד אֶת־ צִיד֥וֹן בְּכֹר֖וֹ וְאֶת־ חֵֽת׃ וְאֶת־ הַיְבוּסִי֙ וְאֶת־ הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַגִּרְגָּשִֽׁי׃ וְאֶת־ הַחִוִּ֥י וְאֶת־ הַֽעַרְקִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַסִּינִֽי׃ וְאֶת־ הָאַרְוָדִ֥י וְאֶת־ הַצְּמָרִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַֽחֲמָתִֽי׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
passages.sermon:
Shem had several sons.
Their names were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
Aram also had sons.
Their names were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י שֵׁ֔ם עֵילָ֣ם וְאַשּׁ֔וּר וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד וְל֣וּד וַאֲרָ֑ם וְע֥וּץ וְח֖וּל וְגֶ֥תֶר וָמֶֽשֶׁךְ׃ס

passages.text: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
passages.sermon:
Arphaxad was a man.
Arphaxad became the father of Shelah.
Shelah was a man.
Shelah became the father of Eber.
passages.original: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד יָלַ֣ד אֶת־ שָׁ֑לַח וְשֶׁ֖לַח יָלַ֥ד אֶת־ עֵֽבֶר׃

passages.text: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
passages.sermon:
Eber was a descendant of Shem.
Eber had two sons.
The first son was Peleg.
People called him Peleg because the earth was divided during his lifetime.
The second son was Joktan.
Joktan was Peleg’s brother.
passages.original: וּלְעֵ֥בֶר יֻלַּ֖ד שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים שֵׁ֣ם הָאֶחָ֞ד פֶּ֗לֶג כִּ֤י בְיָמָיו֙ נִפְלְגָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו יָקְטָֽן׃

passages.text: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah, Obal, Abimael, Sheba, Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
passages.sermon:
Joktan was a man.
Joktan had many sons.
Joktan was the father of Almodad.
Joktan was the father of Sheleph.
Joktan was the father of Hazarmaveth.
Joktan was the father of Jerah.
Joktan was the father of Hadoram.
Joktan was the father of Uzal.
Joktan was the father of Diklah.
Joktan was the father of Obal.
Joktan was the father of Abimael.
Joktan was the father of Sheba.
Joktan was the father of Ophir.
Joktan was the father of Havilah.
Joktan was the father of Jobab.
All these men were sons of Joktan.
passages.original: וְיָקְטָ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־ אַלְמוֹדָ֖ד וְאֶת־ שָׁ֑לֶף וְאֶת־ חֲצַרְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־ יָֽרַח׃ וְאֶת־ הֲדוֹרָ֥ם וְאֶת־ אוּזָ֖ל וְאֶת־ דִּקְלָֽה׃ וְאֶת־ עֵיבָ֥ל וְאֶת־ אֲבִימָאֵ֖ל וְאֶת־ שְׁבָֽא׃ וְאֶת־ אוֹפִ֥יר וְאֶת־ חֲוִילָ֖ה וְאֶת־ יוֹבָ֑ב כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יָקְטָֽן׃ס

passages.text: So from Shem came Arphaxad, Shelah, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Terah, and Abram (that is, Abraham).
passages.sermon:
Shem was the ancestor of Arphaxad.
Arphaxad was the ancestor of Shelah.
Shelah was the ancestor of Eber.
Eber was the ancestor of Peleg.
Peleg was the ancestor of Reu.
Reu was the ancestor of Serug.
Serug was the ancestor of Nahor.
Nahor was the ancestor of Terah.
Terah was the ancestor of Abram.
Abram is also called Abraham.
passages.original: שֵׁ֥ם׀ אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד שָֽׁלַח׃ עֵ֥בֶר פֶּ֖לֶג רְעֽוּ׃ שְׂר֥וּג נָח֖וֹר תָּֽרַח׃ אַבְרָ֖ם ה֥וּא אַבְרָהָֽם׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
passages.sermon: Abraham was the father of Isaac.\r\nAbraham was the father of Ishmael.
passages.original: בְּנֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם יִצְחָ֖ק וְיִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃ס

passages.text: These are their genealogies: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
passages.sermon:
Ishmael was the son of Abraham.
Ishmael had sons.
Nebaioth was the firstborn son of Ishmael.
Kedar was a son of Ishmael.
Adbeel was a son of Ishmael.
Mibsam was a son of Ishmael.
Mishma was a son of Ishmael.
Dumah was a son of Ishmael.
Massa was a son of Ishmael.
Hadad was a son of Ishmael.
Tema was a son of Ishmael.
Jetur was a son of Ishmael.
Naphish was a son of Ishmael.
Kedemah was a son of Ishmael.
These men were the sons of Ishmael.
passages.original: אֵ֖לֶּה תֹּלְדוֹתָ֑ם בְּכ֤וֹר יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ נְבָי֔וֹת וְקֵדָ֥ר וְאַדְבְּאֵ֖ל וּמִבְשָֽׂם׃ מִשְׁמָ֣ע וְדוּמָ֔ה מַשָּׂ֖א חֲדַ֥ד וְתֵימָֽא׃ יְט֥וּר נָפִ֖ישׁ וָקֵ֑דְמָה אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃ס

passages.text: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
passages.sermon:
Keturah was a concubine of Abraham.
Keturah gave birth to sons for Abraham.
Their names were Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
Jokshan was one of Keturah’s sons.
Jokshan had two sons.
Their names were Sheba and Dedan.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֨י קְטוּרָ֜ה פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ אַבְרָהָ֗ם יָלְדָ֞ה אֶת־ זִמְרָ֧ן וְיָקְשָׁ֛ן וּמְדָ֥ן וּמִדְיָ֖ן וְיִשְׁבָּ֣ק וְשׁ֑וּחַ וּבְנֵ֥י יָקְשָׁ֖ן שְׁבָ֥א וּדְדָֽן׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these were Keturah’s sons.
passages.sermon:
Midian had five sons.
Their names were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.
Keturah was their mother.
Keturah was Abraham’s concubine.
All these men were sons of Keturah.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָעֵ֙פֶר֙ וַחֲנ֔וֹךְ וַאֲבִידָ֖ע וְאֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
passages.sermon: Abraham was the father of Isaac.\r\nIsaac had two sons.\r\nTheir names were Esau and Israel.
passages.original: וַיּ֥וֹלֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־ יִצְחָ֑קס בְּנֵ֣י יִצְחָ֔ק עֵשָׂ֖ו וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
passages.sermon: Esau was the father of five sons.\r\nTheir names were Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י עֵשָׂ֑ו אֱלִיפַ֛ז רְעוּאֵ֥ל וִיע֖וּשׁ וְיַעְלָ֥ם וְקֹֽרַח׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
passages.sermon:
Eliphaz was a son of Esau.
Eliphaz had several sons.
Teman was a son of Eliphaz.
Omar was a son of Eliphaz.
Zepho was a son of Eliphaz.
Gatam was a son of Eliphaz.
Kenaz was a son of Eliphaz.
Timna was a woman.
Timna had a son with Eliphaz.
Amalek was the son of Eliphaz and Timna.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י אֱלִיפָ֑ז תֵּימָ֤ן וְאוֹמָר֙ צְפִ֣י וְגַעְתָּ֔ם קְנַ֖ז וְתִמְנָ֥ע וַעֲמָלֵֽק׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
passages.sermon: Reuel was a son of Esau.\r\nReuel had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י רְעוּאֵ֑ל נַ֥חַת זֶ֖רַח שַׁמָּ֥ה וּמִזָּֽה׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
passages.sermon: Seir had sons.\r\nTheir names were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י שֵׂעִ֔יר לוֹטָ֥ן וְשׁוֹבָ֖ל וְצִבְע֣וֹן וַֽעֲנָ֑ה וְדִישֹׁ֥ן וְאֵ֖צֶר וְדִישָֽׁן׃

passages.text: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
passages.sermon:
Lotan had two sons.
Their names were Hori and Homam.
Lotan had a sister.
Her name was Timna.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י לוֹטָ֖ן חֹרִ֣י וְהוֹמָ֑ם וַאֲח֥וֹת לוֹטָ֖ן תִּמְנָֽע׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
passages.sermon:
Shobal was a son of Seir.
Shobal had five sons.
Their names were Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
Zibeon was also a son of Seir.
Zibeon had two sons.
Their names were Aiah and Anah.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹבָ֔ל עַלְיָ֧ן וּמָנַ֛חַת וְעֵיבָ֖ל שְׁפִ֣י וְאוֹנָ֑םס וּבְנֵ֥י צִבְע֖וֹן אַיָּ֥ה וַעֲנָֽה׃

passages.text: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
passages.sermon: Anah had a son named Dishon.\r\nDishon had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָ֖ה דִּישׁ֑וֹןס וּבְנֵ֣י דִישׁ֔וֹן חַמְרָ֥ן וְאֶשְׁבָּ֖ן וְיִתְרָ֥ן וּכְרָֽן׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
passages.sermon:
Ezer had sons.
Ezer’s sons were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
Dishan had sons.
Dishan’s sons were Uz and Aran.
passages.original: בְּֽנֵי־ אֵ֔צֶר בִּלְהָ֥ן וְזַעֲוָ֖ן יַעֲקָ֑ן בְּנֵ֥י דִישׁ֖וֹן ע֥וּץ וַאֲרָֽן׃פ

passages.text: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor. His city was named Dinhabah.
passages.sermon:
These men were kings.
They ruled in the land of Edom.
They ruled before any king ruled over the Israelites.
The first king was Bela.
Bela was the son of Beor.
Bela’s city was named Dinhabah.
passages.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הַמְּלָכִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָלְכוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם לִפְנֵ֥י מְלָךְ־ מֶ֖לֶךְ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בֶּ֚לַע בֶּן־ בְּע֔וֹר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ דִּנְהָֽבָה׃

passages.text: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Bela was a king in the land of Edom.
Bela died.
Jobab became king after Bela.
Jobab was the son of Zerah.
Jobab came from Bozrah.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת בָּ֑לַע וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו יוֹבָ֥ב בֶּן־ זֶ֖רַח מִבָּצְרָֽה׃

passages.text: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Jobab was a king in Edom.
Jobab died.
Husham became king after Jobab.
Husham came from the land of the Temanites.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת יוֹבָ֑ב וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו חוּשָׁ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי׃

passages.text: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
passages.sermon:
Husham died.
Hadad became king after Husham.
Hadad was the son of Bedad.
Hadad defeated Midian in the country of Moab.
Hadad’s city was named Avith.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת חוּשָׁ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜יו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן־ בְּדַ֗ד הַמַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת־ מִדְיָן֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ׃ עֲיוֹת׃

passages.text: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
passages.sermon: Hadad died.\r\nSamlah became king after him.\r\nSamlah came from Masrekah.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שַׂמְלָ֖ה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָֽה׃

passages.text: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Samlah was a king.
Samlah died.
Shaul became king after Samlah.
Shaul came from Rehoboth on the Euphrates.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת שַׂמְלָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שָׁא֖וּל מֵרְחֹב֥וֹת הַנָּהָֽר׃

passages.text: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Shaul was a king.
Shaul died.
Baal-hanan became king after Shaul.
Baal-hanan was the son of Achbor.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן בֶּן־ עַכְבּֽוֹר׃

passages.text: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
passages.sermon:
Baal-hanan died.
Hadad became king after him.
Hadad’s city was called Pau.
Hadad’s wife was Mehetabel.
Mehetabel was the daughter of Matred.
Matred was the daughter of Me-zahab.
passages.original: וַיָּ֙מָת֙ בַּ֣עַל חָנָ֔ן וַיִּמְלֹ֤ךְ תַּחְתָּיו֙ הֲדַ֔ד וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ פָּ֑עִי וְשֵׁ֨ם אִשְׁתּ֤וֹ מְהֵיטַבְאֵל֙ בַּת־ מַטְרֵ֔ד בַּ֖ת מֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: Then Hadad died. Now the chiefs of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth, Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon, Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar, Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
passages.sermon:
Hadad died.
Edom had chiefs.
Their names were Timna, Alvah, and Jetheth.
Oholibamah, Elah, and Pinon were also chiefs.
Kenaz, Teman, and Mibzar were chiefs.
Magdiel and Iram were chiefs too.
These people were the chiefs of Edom.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑דס וַיִּהְיוּ֙ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם אַלּ֥וּף תִּמְנָ֛ע אַלּ֥וּף עַלְיָה אַלּ֥וּף יְתֵֽת׃ אַלּ֧וּף אָהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה אַלּ֥וּף אֵלָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף פִּינֹֽן׃ אַלּ֥וּף קְנַ֛ז אַלּ֥וּף תֵּימָ֖ן אַלּ֣וּף מִבְצָֽר׃ אַלּ֥וּף מַגְדִּיאֵ֖ל אַלּ֣וּף עִירָ֑ם אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֥י אֱדֽוֹם׃פ
